"""The FlowRepository port. Both adapter_methods_without_port and port_methods_without_use_case
read this module: it is the port base infrastructure/kissflow/flow.py implements, and the port
whose two abstract methods G11's use cases are checked against."""

from __future__ import annotations

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Any


class FlowRepository(ABC):
    """One ABC per family, CLAUDE.md > Ports."""

    @abstractmethod
    def get_draft(self, flow_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Read the current draft. Compliant: a use case calls this below."""

    @abstractmethod
    def publish(self, flow_id: str) -> None:
        """Publish the flow. VIOLATION: port_methods_without_use_case -- no use case calls this."""
